CHAIRMAN’S REVIEW It is my privilege to present the Annual Report of The Pakistan General Insurance Company Limited for the year ended December 31, 2025. The year under review represents a significant milestone in the Company’s transformation journey. Following the successful revival of operations, the Company has progressed from stabilization to a phase of structured growth, improved underwriting discipline, and strengthening of its financial position.
